_comment: Per-stage build settings for tools/acrmod/build_stage.py (D-022): everything the automatic export cannot decide. Our own data (names, numbers, choices); WRCG facts come from work/wrcg/<slug>/.
name: WrcgGrSS3
manual_notes: kind 'spline': GR_SS3_TrackSpline holds the whole road; start = WRCG's start grid Start_Pos (55 m along the spline), finish 15 m before the spline end (CFG 4904 m from the grid).
anchor 'route_centre': route 3.35 x 1.1 km with 500 m of climb -> needs larger PhysicsWorldBounds than Hafren's (open, subagent research).
terrain: the whole 4 km level is the window (1,024 tiles of 128 m); terrain_far_grades keep tiles beyond 300 / 800 m at 256 / 128 px.

dressing: WRCG's own SS3 start (STARTENDS/Start/SS3/WRC_STARTER_01, 75 items) and end (ENDING_SS3, 7) prefabs are in stage scope and come with the props; they have no arch -> ACR's 'Rally Greece' gantry (right region here), ACR boards off.
pre_start_m 50: the spline has 55 m of road before the grid.
vegetation: GR_ACROPOLIS replay rules (data/wrcg_vegetation_map.json), first guess.
lat/lon approximate (UI only).

startends_stage SS3 (owner drive 12): WRCG's STARTENDS root holds every Acropolis stage's start/finish prefabs; SS3R finishes at SS3's start (Wolf 'Power Stage finish' arch, marshal tent) and starts at its finish -> only items naming SS3 are kept.

decal_opacity 0.5 / decal_min_roughness 0.75 (owner drive 12): the first hairpin's ~20 overlapping WRCG decals looked 'exaggerated, like ice (shiny), 50 % less pronounced'; the mud tyre print D_MD_TIRE_01_A_N has roughness 0.5.
dressing false (owner drive 13): WRCG's own SS3 start arch (EKO) and finish arch (SS3_Arch_Marketing_Wolf) are in scope; ACR's 'Rally Greece' gantries doubled them.

decal_mark_opacity 0.5 replaces decal_opacity (owner drive 13): halving every decal uncovered the overlap of GR_SS3_ROAD_1.19 and _1.78 at the first hairpin ('clear artifact of trying to join both roads'); only tyre / turn marks are halved now.

start (owner 2026-10-30, D-050 addendum): the line stays at WRCG's Start_Pos grid (s 55 m; moving it to the arch put the car under the arch, 'more nonsensical'); the car stood ~1.4 m right of the grid because Start_Pos lies off WRCG's road spline -> the start trigger (ACR spawns the normal-start car there) is shifted sideways by Start_Pos's offset from the route (build_stage.start_lateral_cm).

2026-11-15 (owner: Kenya's map is nearly optimal, enable the rest): auto_crowd, crowd_penalty and support_vehicles on as in ke_ss2; not enabled here: animals, road_tint/terrain_match, decals:false, ground_cover_pebbles (Kenya-specific). Untested on this stage.

2026-11-18 (owner): crowd_add: 3 spectators 0.8 m behind the red net at route m 1295 (the owner stood on its piece at WRCG 1229.6, 1460.3), each with its own penalty cone (cone_each) 0.2 m from the net so nobody hits the net on purpose there.

2026-11-18 (owner): crowd_sit: 2 spectators sitting on the ground (pose Sitting; SittingRock sits them on a rock) on the little hill at route m 2270 (WRCG 450.7, 1314.1; 7 m from the road), facing the road. ACR's crowd has no kneeling animation.
2026-11-18 (owner): crowd_add: 3 spectators 0.8 m behind the red-white net at route m 3579 (left side, WRCG -692.6, 1292.8), each with its own penalty cone (cone_each).
2026-11-18 (owner): crowd_sit hill people at m 2270 removed (not visible in game, cause not found: ~40 deg slope suspected; see roadmap/GUIA_EDICION_DE_MAPAS.md). The crowd_sit code stays, unused.

2026-11-18 (owner, test): escape_reaction: ACR's BC_CrowdEscapeReaction_C (crowd that runs away when the car passes its trigger) at route m 2979, where the owner stood (WRCG -142.4, 1410.1; 1.9 m left of the road centre, i.e. on the road edge). Variant by side (left of the road -> HandFree_Right_01); trigger 50 m before him. See wr_escape.py. Untested in game.

2026-11-18 (owner): start_marshal_m 13: the countdown marshal stands in line with the start arch (ARCH_START_GR, route m 13) as on Seyabei (arch and marshal both at m 8); the core put him at m 8, 5 m before the arch, nearer the car. Sideways offset unchanged (~3 m left of the arch centre, as on Seyabei). Untested in game.

2026-11-18 (owner): escape_reaction REMOVED from this stage after a first test (the person stood still, never ran); to retry later, add back "escape_reaction": [{"at": [-142.4, 1410.07, 621.65], "trigger_m": 50}] (route m 2979, left edge). The code stays in wr_escape.py; see roadmap/GUIA_EDICION_DE_MAPAS.md and roadmap/ESCAPE_REACTION.md.
